other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage during text vectorization and encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Text vectorizers (like TF-IDF) and frequency encoders are fit on the concatenated train and test sets. This leaks the vocabulary, document frequencies, and categorical distributions of the test set into the training process.

summary: The agent provides a sophisticated solution with extensive feature engineering and a weighted ensemble of gradient boosting models. However, it applies TF-IDF, SVD, and frequency encoding to the entire concatenated dataset prior to cross-validation, leading to severe data leakage. Additionally, it ignores the temporal nature of the dataset by using a random K-Fold split, risking look-ahead bias.
